rules.outside_clip: path bbox does not intersect the block clip — nothing of it is in the crop
rules.zero_opacity: fill_opacity<=0.01 and stroke_opacity<=0.01 — the painter is fully transparent
rules.white_fill_no_stroke: fill is white and there is no stroke colour — a knockout box: it produces 4 phantom rectangle edges but no visible edge on white paper
rules.white_stroke_no_fill: stroke is white and there is no fill — the stroke paints paper on paper
rules.white_fill_white_stroke: both fill and stroke are white — same as above
rules.degenerate: path rect has zero width and zero height
